headline: AI and data engineer building reliable pipelines and ML systems for
intro: Three years shipping production data pipelines, ML workflows, and cloud infrastructure — data quality, observability, and automation, not just a notebook demo.
about: I'm an AI and Data Engineer finishing an MSc in Computing (Artificial Intelligence) at Dublin City University. I build machine learning pipelines, scalable data workflows, and cloud solutions with Python, PySpark, Databricks, and SQL.

At Tanama Software I built ingestion and transformation pipelines on Azure Databricks, helped migrate an enterprise data platform from HDFS to the cloud using a medallion architecture, and added data quality checks that downstream ML workloads depend on. I care about the parts that keep data trustworthy in production: validation, observability, and automation.
projectsIntro: Projects that best show how I design, build, test, and ship data and AI systems.
skillsIntro: Tools I've used to build real systems — not a wishlist.
